26.en: Inquisitors are empowered to commandeer any resource, tool, or individual with little to no justification; thus, it is not uncommon that psykers are often called into Inquisitorial service, plucked from the Black Ships of the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.OjmVcVX5lv76LsvL]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica} or wherever else it suits the Inquisition to find them. Recruiting such dangerous personnel with impunity casts a long shadow over the Inquisition’s reputation, but the organisation as a whole is unbothered. Their unparalleled power, supreme secrecy, and constant exposure to dark, insidious threats open the Holy Orders to continuous scrutiny. Still, few can openly criticise their actions and results. Moreover, the unsettling mystery and dread that psykers bring are often useful tools for performing Inquisitorial duties.

34.en: Beyond the greater Imperium’s attitudes towards psykers, those working within the Inquisition are afforded some protections — similar to their sanctioned positions within the Adeptus Astra Telepathica — but their survival generally depends on the philosophy of the Inquisitor they serve, or indeed are. Psykers are potent weapons in the fight to protect Humanity. They are uniquely well-equipped to thwart psychically formidable xenos, daemonic minions of Chaos, and lurking heretics and mutants. But, psykers are mutants themselves, literal conduits to the hellish Warp, and even the most disciplined psyker is never that far removed from the corruption of the Ruinous Powers.

130.en: GM’s should be aware that any power which allows a character to detect truth from falsehood can impact certain plots and intrigues quite dramatically. Canny GMs will note that NPCs which believe something to be true, even if they are incorrect, do not appear to be lying to the user of Discern Falsehoods. Carefully worded answers may also subvert this power. For example, the statement, ‘Heresy is forbidden, and my station binds me to report even a hint of it,’ is a technically true response to questions such as ‘Are you a heretic,’ even if put to the most fervent follower of Tzeentch. Additionally, psychic powers are generally feared, and any psyker invoking their abhorrent power and then possibly bleeding from the ears is likely to find themselves drawing a great deal of unwelcome attention.
